rationale.edition: Every changed path is open-source: src/** (openobserve Rust backend), web/src/** (Vue UI) and scripts/translations. There are no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/ or enterprise web-layer paths. No isCloud/isEnterprise/withFeatureGate gate is touched in the changed web/src files; the only cfg(feature="enterprise") in the diff is a routing unit test that documents enterprise routes, not a gated feature. The feature runs on the OSS build. [Raised to enterprise by the edition floor: 7/11 changed UI files are enterprise/cloud-gated.]
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no tests-added label or skip comment in the trigger, and the change is clearly user-facing: it alters incident-list and RCA UI in web/src/components/alerts/**, not docs/CI/comment-only files.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change alters several user-facing flows: the incidents list's alert_count column now renders grouped alert chips with count tooltips, the RCA drawer names the step a resumed run restarts from, cancelled runs read 'Cancelled' instead of 'Failed', and RCA deadline/unblocked times now display the viewer's local zone.
rationale.area: Alerts. The bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/components/alerts/** (IncidentList, IncidentRCAAnalysis, rca/RcaVerdictCard, rca/RcaThreadColumn), supported by web/src/services/incidents.ts and web/src/utils/incidents/*. Sibling alert specs belong in the Alerts folder.
rationale.group: Alerts. It is the OSS ci-matrix shard group for the alerts area — the enterprise overlay's append/disabled sections reference an OSS 'Alerts' group, and incident/RCA specs fit that shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit tests under web/src/**/*.spec.ts (IncidentList.spec.ts, IncidentRCAAnalysis.spec.ts, RcaThreadColumn.spec.ts, RcaVerdictCard.spec.ts, rcaCell.spec.ts, rcaThread.spec.ts, RichTextInput.spec.ts), which are unit coverage, not E2E coverage.
